gloss: to be injured; to be wounded

definitions.gloss: to be injured; to be wounded
definitions.explanation: To suffer a physical injury, especially in an accident, disaster, or conflict. A formal word common in news reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{負傷|ふしょう}する。
examples.english: To be injured in an accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{試合中|しあいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{負傷|ふしょう}した。
examples.english: The player was injured during the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{負傷|ふしょう}し、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Many people were injured in the earthquake and taken to the hospital.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive suru verb. X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{負傷|ふしょう}する. The noun ⟦{負傷|ふしょう}→負傷：15287_fushou⟧ also stands alone.

Formal; common in news reports. Everyday speech uses ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{負傷|ふしょう}する: to be injured in an accident
- ⟦{負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}→負傷者：27169_fushousha⟧: an injured person; casualty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get hurt — everyday and neutral
- ⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to be seriously injured
